spec_features.spec_quote: if the agent clearly signals completion (the done heuristic), we respect that
spec_features.evidence: agent.py: run_agent() loop calls _looks_done(result.content). When the agent emits a pure-text message (no tool calls) matching markers, it sets transcript.termination='agent_done' and returns, ending the loop (agent.py ~lines 104-110). Also for finish_reason in ('stop','length') with no tool calls and a done-phrase, it returns 'agent_done' (~lines 118-129). _looks_done markers include 'i give up','giving up','i cannot make further progress','i've exhausted' (agent.py _looks_done). This is genuinely dispatched and honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end enforced: the heuristic return actually breaks out of the turn loop and terminates the run. Note there is no dedicated exit/finish tool; termination relies purely on text pattern matching of the assistant message.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: treat as done to avoid empty-spinning
